input.name: x
input.note: TFLite's 8-bit input tensor, transposed from NHWC to planar NCHW; the models dequantize it themselves

output_note: float32, TFLite's layout and order; value = (q - zero) * scale, q = round(value / scale) + zero. scale 0: not quantized in TFLite, the float32 holds the integer

q.activations: int8 QDQ on TFLite's grids, int8 per-channel weights, int32 bias

f16.activations: float16, weights dequantized, no quantize pairs
